dmp.description: This DMP supports the research project aimed at exploring institutional, technical, and human-centered mechanisms for providing electronic public services in Ukraine during the post-war recovery period. The plan outlines how data will be collected, processed, stored, and shared with an emphasis on cybersecurity and interoperability.

project.description: An individual doctoral research project on educational governance mechanisms in transitional societies, conducted at the National University of Kyiv-Mohyla Academy
project.title: Educational Governance in Transition (PhD Dissertation)

dmp.title: Mechanisms of Electronic Service Delivery in Ukraine's Post-War Recovery Period
